title: AS ABOVE / SO BELOW
motionSummary: Opposed triangle edge illumination, mirrored meridian, rotating dial hands, alternating star points and a luminance-masked paint sweep.

title: TRANSMUTE
motionSummary: Letter-face highlights, painted halo tracing, moving vinyl groove glints, glowing alchemist eyes and pendant, and rippling street reflections.

title: THE MAP IS NOT THE TERRITORY
motionSummary: Staggered light inside the real city windows, travelling architectural linework, the framed skyline halo and alternating compass-star glints.

title: KNOW THYSELF
motionSummary: Two engraved eyes open, blink and follow attention; distinct upper/lower word highlights, a pulsing central star and travelling compass arcs.

title: SHADOW WORK
motionSummary: Watchful triangle and pendant eyes, light travelling through mask cracks and hood folds, engraved halo traces and a crescent-dial glint.

title: OMERTÀ WITH THE EGO
motionSummary: Paired large engraved irises track the pointer and blink together, a third eye opens, lettering carries mirrored highlights and the central dial turns.

title: THE CITY REMEMBERS
motionSummary: Staggered apartment lights, antenna and staircase signals, vinyl groove glints, rooftop compass flashes and a restrained architectural light pass.
